description: Email a sanitized Drawing MCP Server issue to the maintainer. Show the report for review and call only after explicit user approval. Free of CAD call quota; no drawing or credentials are attached automatically. Generate one UUID reportId and preserve the exact payload for authorized retries; never retry automatically after a timeout. Optional contact requires an explicitly supplied reporterEmail; no account lookup is performed. Optional host-supplied attachment bytes only: never invent base64 or read server paths.

approved.description: User approved this report and every attachment.

attachments.description: User-approved txt/log/json/csv/png/jpg/jpeg/pdf bytes, 5 MiB combined. DWGs and filesystem paths are not accepted.

reporterEmail.description: Explicit contact address only for opted-in contact. Omit for none.

name: cad.report_issue
title: Report an issue
